This '''[[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S swoop]]''' belonged to [[Kimmi Chyler]], the most successful female swoop racer in the sport during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The thrusters and steering vanes of the swoop were envied by Chyler's competitors.
